tools.name: search_reports
tools.description: Find Stratum Market Research global market reports by product, industry or keyword (for example "lithium battery", "frozen shrimp", "cardiac stents"). Returns report titles, page URLs, the headline figure with its unit and the update date. Use get_report for the full figures.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Get the published figures of one market report as Markdown: world market size and trade value with years, growth since 2019, the largest exporting and importing countries, what the market covers, FAQs, editions and how to cite. Accepts a report slug, page URL or market name.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a question about a market, figure, country, edition or price, in plain English. The answer is built only from Stratum's published pages and lists the pages to cite. Optionally pass a report slug to focus on one market.

tools.name: search_rankings
tools.description: Find data-defined top-10 company and country rankings by topic (for example "oncology trial sponsors", "medical device clearances").

tools.name: get_ranking
tools.description: Get one ranking as Markdown: rank, company or country, its value, the measure and the period. Accepts a ranking slug, page URL or title.

tools.name: get_editions
tools.description: Prices in USD, delivery times and contents of the three report editions, and how to order a report or request a free sample.
